When the belt speed is increased or decreased, the riser pump speed may also need to be adjusted. Changes in pump speed can cause the chocolate temperature to increase or decrease.

Operators often adjust the pump flow to achieve the desired center weight. They must closely monitor the process and make the necessary adjustments on the tempering machine according to the center line.

I recommend removing the Flavor Agitator when processing chocolate without added flavors, especially dark chocolate, because it is more viscous.

Over time, chocolate can build up on the inside walls of the pipe, restricting flow. This may require increasing the Riser Pump speed to maintain the desired flow.

The Flavor Agitator has already been removed, cleaned, and placed on the shelf behind the Kitchen, where it is clearly visible so operators can easily verify whether it is installed or removed.

The Flavor Agitator must always be cleaned before being reinstalled.
